title: A Unified Zeroth-Order Approach for Decentralized Minimax Optimization
summary: We propose ZOMA, a unified Zeroth-Order decentralized accelerated MinimAx framework for multi-agent nonconvex Polyak--Łojasiewicz minimax optimization. The proposed framework only requires evaluating the function value and, as such, is tailored to gradient-free environments, where exact gradient information is either unavailable or computationally prohibitive to obtain.
